title: schmaltzia trilobata
intro: Schmaltzia trilobata, commonly known as the Schmaltzia or Pilocarpus, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Schmaltzia trilobata include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating coughs and colds. Its bioactive constituents include volatile oils and flavonoids, such as limonene and geraniol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
